text:
sara: Heads up — noticed a weird pattern on prod SSEs this morning: clients reconnecting twice within the inflight window and triggering the circuit-breaker, which then causes the console to show duplicated quota/credits usage.

sam: ugh. is this the same thing we saw during the EU spike last month? :grimacing:

sara: similar surface, but different root. this time the probe TTL is shorter than our inflight-window grace, so client reconnects while the backend still considers the old socket 'inflight'. proxy marks it as duplicate and cuts traffic -> cb trips -> client retries -> billing shows 2 short-lived sessions.

deepak: can you paste the relevant logs? especially the headers around x-inflight-window / resume-id.

sara: here are a few snippets:
```
[edge] accept: conn_id=abc123 resume_id=rt-789 inflight-window=45ms
[proxy] new_conn: conn_id=def456 resume_id=rt-789 seen_recent=true -> mark_duplicate
[cb] trip: duplicate_session_rate=0.8 window_ms=50
```

jordan: hmm, looks like proxy dedupe uses a strict recent-seen boolean whereas billing/console aggregates by resume_id TTL. mismatch there. proxy treats any duplicate within N ms as lethal, but circuit-breaker expects a smoother rate.

sam: iirc we added the strict dedupe to prevent double-fanout, but didn't teach the cb about the short transient duplicates. we could: 1) relax proxy dedupe to a soft-suppress (allow but tag), 2) add a short dedupe-bucket in the circuit-breaker to ignore immediate self-generated retry storms, or 3) change console billing to de-duplicate based on resume_id+short TTL.

sara: option 2 seems lowest risk for runtime; option 3 is heavy and affects billing pipeline. option 1 might reintroduce double-fanout in edge cases.

deepak: quick experiment idea — can we flip proxy to 'tag-only' for a single canary shard and observe console counts? we can tag via header X-SSE-DUPE=tagged and add a console filter.

ops-bot: deploy request queued by linda: roll proxy dedupe -> tag-only on shard s-eu-canary (change set: proxy/dedupe: soft=true)

linda: deploying canary now, will monitor inflight duplicates and billing visualization for the next 30m. alerting on >1.2x baseline.

sam: also add a short-lived metric: sse.resume.duplicate.local_tagged to trace whether these are self-retries vs client multi-connections.

jordan: follow-up: we should capture the client-side reconnect jitter and surfaced TTLs in the console trace so folks can correlate client SDK versions. i can sketch a console UX for a 'resume heatmap' that overlays resume_id churn vs credits.

sara: that would help catch SDKs that aggressively retry. for now, if canary looks good we can roll tag-only for 2 regions and open a billing rollback play if credits delta > 5%.

linda: canary metrics look ok at +3% spike, but duplicates flagged as tagged in logs dropped by 95%. holding for 45 more minutes then widening.

sam: thanks — if we still see tiny bursts, i'll add a cb patch to ignore duplicates within 100ms per resume_id.

sara: noted. i'll file a follow-up ticket to track console de-dupe vs billing. ticket: infra#9872.

jordan: thanks team, great quick canary. :thumbsup:
